### Undeserving, Yet Unconditionally Loved
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-august-14-2023.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 15:10
Points:
- Paul understood that his calling and standing resulted solely from God's unmerited favor rather than his own goodness.
- Contemporary culture celebrates self-made achievement, but the Christian's proper posture is to credit grace for every accomplishment.
- Experiencing the Lord's unconditional love should motivate believers to extend that same grace and acceptance to others.

### The Gospel Summarized
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-gospel-summarized
Passage: 1 Corinthians 15:3-7
Points:
- The essential core of the Christian gospel is Christ's sacrificial death for sins, His burial, and His bodily resurrection.
- These events were not unforeseen accidents but took place in exact fulfillment of the Old Testament Scriptures.
- The resurrection is grounded in objective history through numerous eyewitness testimonies.
- Believers must cherish the Old Testament because it provides the indispensable framework for understanding Jesus and His redemption.
